items.title: test(mcpx): enumerate the exec/run flag set — completeness guard for flag-probe rows (#2188)
items.body: Implements #2188 (leak 1 of #1971): `TestEveryExecFlagChangesSomething` now actually **enumerates** the exec/run flag set instead of relying on a comment asking for a row per new flag. **What changed** - `internal/cli/execflagcoverage.go` — the probe contract: `ExecFlagProbes` (one e2e probe row per name) and `ExecFlagExemptions` (reasoned, ratcheted exemptions), following the `handFlagsMeaningOther` precedent of contract data in a non-test file both test packages read. - `TestExecFlagSetIsFullyProbed` (internal/cli, unit-speed ~0ms) — enumerates the **real** exec and run FlagSets via the existing `parseFlagsHook` idiom (193 flags each on current main), partitions registry-bound flags (whose reach is guarded by `TestEverySettingFlagReachesTheResolvedValue`; hand flags tee-bound to a setting count as registry-covered, `handFlagsMeaningOther` names excepted) from hand-written flags, and fails on: any hand-written flag with neither a row nor an exemption, exec/run hand-set divergence, stale/duplicated/clashing contract entries. - e2e: rows move to package level (`execFlagProbeRows`); a new **`--validate` probe row** (`want: "valid=true"`, script not executed); `TestExecFlagProbeRowsMatchCoverage` pins the rows to the contract in both directions. - The three #75 flags (`--no-launcher`, `--allow-repeat`, `--no-capture-console`) already had rows on current main; every remaining hand-written flag is now dispositioned: 13 probed, 13 exempt with the reason a with/without output row cannot probe it (rendering-only, model-backed, cross-run session continuity, timing-by-construction, …). `ns` keeps a named follow-on on #2188 (needs a multi-namespace env). **Verification (laptop; mcpx has no PR-triggered test CI)** - `go test ./internal/e2e/ -run TestEveryExecFlagChangesSomething` — full guard, 13 rows × local/remote — **PASS** - `go test ./internal/cli/` — full package incl. new completeness test and flagreach — **PASS** - Completeness test demonstrably fails on an undispositioned flag during development (initial run flagged the tee-bound partition, which is now modeled explicitly). Closes the implementation task for #2188; the issue stays open for the `ns` multi-namespace probe follow-on named in the exemptions. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: mcpx: register --remote-file in exec-flag coverage contract + regenerate flag index (follow-up to #8019)
items.body: Follow-up to PR #8019 (#2168), from lane code-w task 14339's post-merge re-verification. ## Problem The merged --remote-file flag was never registered in the exec-flag coverage contract (#2188), so two internal/cli guards fail on current main: - TestExecFlagSetIsFullyProbed: exec --remote-file and run --remote-file are hand-written flags with no probe row and no exemption. - TestHandFlagIndexIsCurrent: flagindex_generated.go is stale (missing the new flag). ## Fix - execflagcoverage.go: reasoned exemption for remote-file. The probe guard's rows pass inline source, which --remote-file refuses by design, so a with/without inline row can observe only the refusal, never the daemon-side resolution. The resolution itself is covered in internal/scriptresolve, internal/execsvc (resolve_test.go), and internal/daemon. - flagindex_generated.go: regenerated via go test ./internal/cli/ -run TestHandFlagIndexIsCurrent -update (+2 lines: exec/run remote-file). ## Verification (laptop, this branch; logs read back from disk) - go build ./... — pass. - go test ./internal/cli/ — ok (28.4s), both guards pass. - go test ./internal/e2e/ -run TestExecFlagProbeRowsMatchCoverage — ok. - Adjacent packages re-checked on the #8019 head: internal/scriptresolve ok, internal/execsvc ok, internal/daemon ok. - internal/settings has 5 failing tests that fail identically on clean main (verified at afeccac879) — pre-existing, tracked on #2716, untouched here. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added the `--remote-file` option to `exec` and `run`, allowing a script name to be resolved using the remote daemon’s script search path.

items.title: mcpx: dependency configuration chain, slice 1 — deps.* settings, paths.deps, ExecOptions.deps (#1913)
items.body: Slice 1 of #1913 (queue task 3191): the dependency configuration chain's configuration + transport half. Follow-up of the design/analysis on #1913; remaining slice-1 items (runner emission, plugin parity) are listed at the bottom. ## What this slice does - **Settings**: `deps.*` group (source, manifest, autoInstall, frozen, + `paths.deps`) declared in the settings registry and read through accessors; `docs/configuration.md` / `docs/environment.md` regenerated. - **`internal/deps`**: `Config`/`From`, scope-aware `Parse`, `Conflicts`, manifest Find/Load/walk-up, JSONC stripping, the `Set`/`Resolve` chain, `Frozen`, `Describe`, and JSON/lockfile text forms — with chain tests. - **Transport**: `execsvc.Options.Deps` (+ `DepsOptions`) carries the dependency set as *text, not paths* (a path would name the caller's filesystem); CLI `a.depsOptions` wired into the exec and run wire paths, with CLI tests. ## Tests Laptop: `go test ./internal/deps/ ./internal/execsvc/` pass; `internal/settings` shows only the two failures that also fail on clean origin/main (verified in a detached worktree at origin/main): `TestTheReadByColumnIsWhatTheCodeReads`, `TestEveryDocumentHasAChapter`. Full `go test ./...` runs in CI. ## Remaining (tracked on task 3191's checkpoint) - internal/runner emission: deno `npm:` specifiers / deno.json imports map; bun/node materialised package.json in the exec workdir; frozen lockfile honoured (bun --frozen-lockfile / npm ci / deno.lock), never rewriting a user project; autoInstall → `--install=` mapping. - Flag reach: `Commands: runCommands` on the deps settings so `--deps-source/--deps-manifest/--deps-autoInstall/--paths-deps` reach run+exec (flagreach parity test). - Plugin parity check for Deps on the exec path. - `docs/proposals.md` "Modules and libraries" status truth-up. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Configure script dependencies with package requests, project manifests, and dependency paths. * Choose dependency sources and whether supported runtimes install dependencies automatically. * Dependencies and relevant lockfiles are prepared for script execution, including local package references and runtime-specific lockfile selection. * Manifest discovery can use the script’s directory, and JSONC manifests are supported. * **Bug Fixes** * Conflicting package versions are reported as errors instead of proceeding with incompatible dependency requests. * **Documentation** * Added reference material for dependency settings and their behavior.
